summary: IRSA Investments & Representations Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting the signing of a barter agreement for a 6,947 sqm lot in the Ramblas del Plata project with an estimated total saleable area of 17,500 sqm. The transaction amounts to USD 14.175 million, paid via upfront cash and future saleable sqm. This is a routine business development—an asset sale/development update—not a special situation (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, restructuring). No board recommendation, advisor, or structural details beyond standard project commercialization.
